title: Reliability rollup over-reports one service's ERROR count
summary: The nightly per-service ERROR-line rollup reports more errors for one service than the metering dashboard, so the on-call engineer cannot trust it.

company.notes: Log-ingestion reliability report; subtle logic flaw, no syntax error, no crash.

expected_output:
=== ERROR lines by service ===
gateway: 0
catalog: 0
payments: 3
notifications: 2
buggy_output:
=== ERROR lines by service ===
gateway: 0
catalog: 0
payments: 3
notifications: 5

phase2.spec_patch: Ops also wants each service's WARN count, because a rise in warnings tends to precede incidents. Keep the same header line, but print each row as `service: errors=<e> warns=<w>`. The WARN lines are already in the feed today.
phase2.fixture_patch:
2026-07-14T10:05:01Z gateway WARN upstream latency 903ms
2026-07-14T10:05:04Z payments WARN retrying charge in 4s
2026-07-14T10:05:06Z payments WARN retrying charge in 8s
phase2.expected_output_v2:
=== ERROR lines by service ===
gateway: errors=0 warns=2
catalog: errors=0 warns=1
payments: errors=3 warns=3
notifications: errors=2 warns=1
